claims.statement: The ideal diode law relates current exponentially to applied voltage through kT/q at fixed temperature.

citations.locator: Diode Equation, ideal equation and thermal-voltage definition
citations.note: Read during initial preparation; later automated fetches timed out.

claims.note: Assessment covers the selected scoped claim, not every sentence.

examples.scope: Published charge-balance, diode, gate-bias, NAND, density and power tables; worked energy and duty-cycle answers; prerequisite ordering.

limitations: Abrupt depletion, ideal exponential diodes, switch resistances, lumped capacitance and independent standby blocks are teaching models with supplied inputs, not validated device specifications.
Leakage mechanisms and scaling outcomes depend on technology and operating conditions; no universal quantitative process trend is asserted.
